changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 6a item 2b: turned service/agent/factory.ts's createTeammateService pure-forwarder function into an AgentServiceFactory class, constructed once per dispatcher as new AgentServiceFactory(dispatcherId, admissions) in dispatcher-service/index.ts where the AdmissionLedger used to be constructed alone. dispatcherId and the AdmissionLedger are now bound at construction instead of threaded through every call, so its create(input) method drops the now-redundant dispatcherId and admissions fields from CreateTeammateServiceInput (renamed CreateAgentServiceInput) -- every other field (identity, options, config, agentRuntimeProviders, identities, onPersisted, peers, worktrees, conversationProjection, log) is unchanged. Propagated the factory (replacing the raw AdmissionLedger) through DispatcherAgentDeps, TeamServiceDeps, TeamCollectionOptions, and TeammateCollectionOptions, and updated the three createTeammateService call sites (dispatcher-service/agent.ts, team-service/leader-agent.ts, service/agent/index.ts's TeammateCollection.buildEntity) to call factory.create(...) instead. Construction-path refactor only: the ledger is still exactly one per dispatcher, with the same window/eviction policy, so no observable behavior changed.
